why: Audit finding on 31/08: the 100755 mode of the hooks was guaranteed once, at creation, and nothing kept it there. A `git update-index --chmod=-x` — or a file created on Windows, where the bit does not exist — puts the hook back to 100644, and on Linux git starts IGNORING IT in silence: the installer prints "hooks installed" and nothing runs. The gate declares itself on and does nothing, which is the worst possible state. The mode checked is the INDEX one, because a local `chmod` does not travel in the clone.
